items.title: 3.5 Real World Problems of Quadratic Equations and Inequalities (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Ab tak humne equations ko "seedha" hal kiya: equation di gayi thi, humne jawab nikaala. Lekin asal zindagi mein equation koi nahin deta; hamare paas ek kahani hoti hai: kamre ka area itna hai, company ka munafa itna hai. Is sabaq mein hum seekhenge ke aisi kahani ko equation mein kaise badla jaye. Yahi maths ka sab se kaam ka hunar hai, aur exam mein bhi word problems par achhe number milte hain.
Kitab kehti hai: ab hum aise sawal hal karenge jo symbols mein likhe jayein to ek ya do variables wali quadratic equations ban jate hain. Aise sawal hal karne ke liye humein yeh karna hai:

items: Anjaan (unknown) cheezon ko \(x\) ya \(y\) waghera maan lein.
Sawal ko symbols mein badlein aur di gayi sharait ko poora karne wali equations banayein.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Kitab ke in do qadmon ke baad har word problem ko teen aur qadmon se mukammal karein:
iii. Equation (ya inequality) ko kisi bhi aate hue tareeqe se hal karein.
iv. Matlab samjhein: jo value halaat mein be-maani ho (negative lambai, aadha insaan) use reject karein, aur jawab ke saath units likhein.
v. Jawab ko sirf equation mein nahin, sawal ke alfaaz se bhi check karein.
Kuch kaam ke "tarjume" (translations): "hai" \(\to\) \(=\); "3 zyada" \(\to\) \(+3\); "kam az kam" (at least) \(\to\) \(\ge\); "zyada se zyada" (at most) \(\to\) \(\le\); rectangle ka area \(=\) lambai \(\times\) chaurai.
Ek misaal se samjhein: "ek number apne square se 6 kam hai" ka tarjuma: \(x = x^{2} - 6\). Alfaaz ko tukdon mein tor kar har tukde ka symbol likhein.
Dhyan dein: sab se mushkil kaam hal karna nahin, balke sahi equation banana hai. Is liye sawal do dafa parhein, jo cheez maloom nahin us ke neeche line lagayein, aur har shart ko alag alag likh lein. Jab equation sahi ban jaye to baqi kaam wahi purana factorisation ya formula hai jo aap ko pehle se aata hai.
Kitab kehti hai ke yeh tareeqa neeche ki misaalon se samjhaya jayega. Pehli misaal ek kamre ki hai, doosri ek company ke munafe ki.

blocks.title: Example 9
blocks.problem: The length of a room is 3 metres greater than its breadth. If the area of the room is 180 square metres, find the length and the breadth of the room.
steps:
Given: lambai (length) = chaurai (breadth) + 3 metres; area = 180 square metres.
To find: kamre ki lambai aur chaurai.
Method: sab se pehle dekhte hain ke kaun si cheez maloom nahin: chaurai aur lambai. Lekin lambai chaurai ke zariye bataayi gayi hai, is liye ek hi variable kaafi hai. Chaurai \(= x\) rakhenge, to lambai \(= x + 3\). Area = lambai \(\times\) chaurai se quadratic equation banegi. Hal kar ke sirf woh value rakhenge jo lambai ke liye maqool (sensible) ho.

Step 1: Unknowns ko naam dein
Maan lijiye kamre ki chaurai \(= x\) metres.
To kamre ki lambai \(= (x + 3)\) metres.
\[\text{Area} = x(x + 3)\ \text{m}^{2}\]
Kyun: yeh method ka step (i) hai: anjaan cheezon ko \(x\) maan lena. Lambai "chaurai se 3 zyada" hai, is liye use \(x + 3\) likha. Agar do alag variables lete to do equations banani parti; ek variable se kaam seedha ho gaya.

Step 2: Equation banayein
Sawal ki shart ke mutabiq:
\[x(x + 3) = 180 \quad \text{...(i)}\]
\[x^{2} + 3x - 180 = 0 \quad \text{...(ii)}\]
Kyun: yeh step (ii) hai: sawal ki zabaan ("area 180 hai") ko symbols mein badalna. Bracket khol kar \(x^{2} + 3x\) bana, aur 180 ko left par le aaye taa ke standard form mil jaye.

Step 3: Factorise karein
Aise do numbers chahiye jin ka product \(-180\) aur jama \(3\) ho: woh \(15\) aur \(-12\) hain.
\[x^{2} + 15x - 12x - 180 = 0\]
\[x(x + 15) - 12(x + 15) = 0\]
\[(x + 15)(x - 12) = 0\]
\[x = -15 \ \text{ya}\ x = 12\]
Kyun: \(15 \times (-12) = -180\) aur \(15 + (-12) = 3\). Product negative hai, is liye ek number positive aur ek negative hoga; jama positive hai, is liye bara number positive hoga. Yeh soch kar numbers jaldi milte hain.

Step 4: Be-maani value ko reject karein
Chaurai negative nahin ho sakti; \(-15\) metre ka kamra koi nahin hota. Is liye \(x = -15\) qabool nahin (not admissible). To \(x = 12\).
Kyun: equation ko kya pata ke woh kamre ke baare mein hai! Algebra dono jawab deta hai; asal duniya ka matlab hum ne khud lagana hai. Lambai, chaurai, waqt, logon ki tadaad jaisi cheezein negative nahin hotin.

Step 5: Lambai nikaalein
\[x + 3 = 12 + 3 = 15\]
Kyun: lambai ko shuru mein \(x + 3\) maana tha, ab \(x = 12\) rakh diya.

Tasdeeq:
Lambai \(-\) chaurai \(= 15 - 12 = 3\) metres. Sahi.
\[\text{Area} = 15 \times 12 = 180\ \text{m}^{2}\]
Sawal ki dono sharait poori ho gayin, is liye jawab durust hai.
blocks.answer: Kamre ki chaurai = 12 metres aur lambai = 15 metres.

blocks.title: Example 10
blocks.problem: A company manufactures laptops and its weekly profit function (in thousands of dollars) is \(P(x) = -x^{2} + 2x + 3\), where \(x\) is the number of laptops produced (in hundreds). Find the range of production levels where the company makes at least \(\$4{,}000\) profit.
steps:
Given: \(P(x) = -x^{2} + 2x + 3\) (munafa hazaar dollars mein), \(x\) = banaye gaye laptops, saikron (hundreds) mein.
To find: \(x\) ki woh values jin par munafa kam az kam \(\$4{,}000\) ho.
Method: sab se pehle units samajhte hain: \(P\) hazaron mein hai, to \(\$4{,}000\) ka matlab number 4 hai. "Kam az kam" (at least) ka matlab \(\ge\). Is tarah sawal ban jata hai \(P(x) \ge 4\), jo ek quadratic inequality (adam masawat) hai. Ise simplify kar ke hal karenge.

Step 1: Shart ko symbols mein likhein
\[P(x) \ge 4\]
Kyun: \(P\) hazaar dollars mein naapa gaya hai, is liye \(\$4{,}000\) ki jagah 4 likha. "At least" yani "is se kam nahin": barabar bhi chalega, zyada bhi.
Dhyan dein: yahan 4000 likh dena aam ghalti hai; phir poora sawal ghalat ho jata hai. Units hamesha pehle dekhein.

Step 2: \(P(x)\) rakhein aur sab kuch ek taraf layein
\[-x^{2} + 2x + 3 \ge 4\]
\[-x^{2} + 2x + 3 - 4 \ge 0\]
\[-x^{2} + 2x - 1 \ge 0\]
Kyun: inequality ko zero se compare karna aasan hota hai; phir sirf yeh dekhna hota hai ke expression positive hai ya negative.

Step 3: \(-1\) se multiply karein
\[x^{2} - 2x + 1 \le 0\]
Kyun: inequality ko negative number se multiply karein to nishan ulat jata hai (\(\ge\) ban jata hai \(\le\)). Misaal: \(3 > 2\), lekin \(-3 < -2\). Is se \(x^{2}\) wala term positive ho gaya aur pehchaan aasan ho gayi.

Step 4: Perfect square pehchaanein
\[(x - 1)^{2} \le 0\]
Kyun: \(x^{2} - 2x + 1 = x^{2} - 2(x)(1) + 1^{2}\), jo formula \(a^{2} - 2ab + b^{2} = (a - b)^{2}\) ki shakal hai.

Step 5: Hal karein
Kisi bhi real number ka square kabhi negative nahin hota: har \(x\) ke liye \((x - 1)^{2} \ge 0\). To \((x - 1)^{2} \le 0\) sirf tab sach hai jab
\[(x - 1)^{2} = 0 \Rightarrow x = 1\]
Kyun: jo cheez ek hi waqt mein \(\ge 0\) bhi ho aur \(\le 0\) bhi, woh sirf zero ho sakti hai.

Step 6: Matlab samjhein
\(x = 1\) ka matlab hai 1 saikra, yani 100 laptops. Is level par munafa theek \(\$4{,}000\) hai; kisi bhi aur level par is se kam.
Kyun: sawal laptops aur dollars ke baare mein hai, is liye jawab bhi unhi units mein dena hai, sirf "\(x = 1\)" likhna adhoora hai.

Tasdeeq:
\[P(1) = -1 + 2 + 3 = 4\]
\[P(0) = 3 < 4,\quad P(2) = 3 < 4\]
Completing the square se: \(P(x) = 4 - (x - 1)^{2}\). Is mein \((x - 1)^{2}\) hamesha 0 ya zyada hai, is liye \(P(x)\) zyada se zyada 4 ho sakta hai, aur woh bhi sirf \(x = 1\) par. Jawab pakka.
blocks.answer: Sirf \(x = 1\), yani 100 laptops: is par company ko theek \(\$4{,}000\) munafa hota hai, aur koi production level aisa nahin jis par munafa \(\$4{,}000\) se zyada ho.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Example 10 ka rishta 3.1.2 se hai: completing the square se \(P(x) = -(x - 1)^{2} + 4\) milta hai. Yeh parabola neeche ki taraf khulta hai (kyun ke \(x^{2}\) ka coefficient negative hai) aur us ka vertex (choti) \((1, 4)\) hai. Matlab 4 hazaar dollars sab se zyada (maximum) munafa hai. Ab "kam az kam maximum" sirf vertex par hi ho sakta hai, isi liye jawab ek hi production level hai, koi interval (wasat) nahin. Sochiye: agar sawal "kam az kam \(\$3{,}000\)" poochta to jawab ek poora interval hota.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari apni misaal hai (kitab ka sawal nahin): do lagataar (consecutive) positive integers ka product 56 hai. Numbers kya hain?
Step (i): chhota number \(= x\), to agla number \(= x + 1\).
Step (ii): \(x(x + 1) = 56\), yani \(x^{2} + x - 56 = 0\).
Hal: \((x + 8)(x - 7) = 0\), to \(x = -8\) ya \(x = 7\).
Matlab: numbers positive hone chahiye, is liye \(-8\) reject. Numbers 7 aur 8 hain.
Tasdeeq: \(7 \times 8 = 56\), aur 7, 8 waqai lagataar hain.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Example 10 mein agar sawal hota "munafa kam az kam \(\$3{,}000\)" to inequality kya banti? (Ishara: \(-x^{2} + 2x + 3 \ge 3\), yani \(x(x - 2) \le 0\), jis ka hal \(0 \le x \le 2\) hai: 0 se 200 laptops tak.)

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Word problem mein har unknown ke liye "Let ..." (maan lijiye) wali line likhein, value reject karte waqt wajah likhein ("breadth cannot be negative"), aur aakhri jawab units ke saath poore jumle mein dein. In lines par alag number milte hain, aur examiner ko aap ki soch saaf nazar aati hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Anjaan cheez ko \(x\) maanein; baqi cheezein \(x\) ke zariye likhein.
2. Sharait ko equation ya inequality mein badal kar standard form banayein.
3. Hal karein, phir sirf woh values rakhein jo asal halaat mein maqool hon.
4. "At least" yani \(\ge\); inequality ko negative se multiply karein to nishan ulat jata hai.
5. Jawab units ke saath jumle mein dein aur sawal ke alfaaz se check karein.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Negative lambai ya chaurai ko jawab mein rakh lena. Bachne ka tareeqa: jawab likhne se pehle poochein "kya yeh asal duniya mein mumkin hai?"
2. Units nazarandaz karna: Example 10 mein \(\$4{,}000\) ka matlab \(P = 4\) hai (kyun ke \(P\) hazaron mein hai), aur \(x = 1\) ka matlab 100 laptops.
3. \(-1\) se multiply karte waqt inequality ka nishan na palatna.
4. \(x = 12\) par ruk jana aur lambai na nikaalna, jab ke sawal dono cheezein poochta hai.
